title: New Orleans bands in Baton Rouge: Kid Ory battles and Mardi Gras
summary: Joe recalls only New Orleans bands coming to Baton Rouge, including Kid Ory battling Toots Johnson, and the town's own Mardi Gras.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: Well, Evan did have a very, very big reputation around those little towns. Lots of musicians from those towns; they all talk about Evan.
I never remembered Evan Thomas or any of those other bands coming into Baton Rouge. The bands I remember mostly were all New Orleans bands, including Kid
Ory. And sometimes Kid Ory and Toots Johnson would hook up there, in a battle of bands.
They had those in Baton Rouge, too?
Oh, yes. Especially like on the Mardi Gras day. You know, they had a Mardi Gras day in Baton Rouge.
I just was going to ask you. I thought that was only in New Orleans...

It was nothing as big and elaborate as Carnival in New Orleans, but oh yeah, we had a Mardi Gras day. Guys would mask up and everything, and bands would parade, and then they'd bring a band from New Orleans.

Well, they have Mardi Gras in Munich, Germany, and they call it "faschen"(?) or something, so I guess they would have it in somewhere like Baton Rouge. But it never occurs to you. Everything in the Deep South centers around New Orleans, so you naturally think of the New Orleans Mardi Gras.
Well, the thing about it, Barry, you know, everybody can't go to New Orleans.
So them guys in all the little towns, in Baton Rouge, they would have a Mardi Gras day on that exact Tuesday.
